description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for CoAP adapter integration tests in the Eclipse Hono project. It provides setup, configuration, and utility methods for testing CoAP server communication, including TLS-PSK authentication, message sending, and response validation. The class abstracts resource URLs, request creation, and response assertions to be implemented or extended by subclasses for specific test cases.

classes.name: CoapTestBase
classes.description: Abstract base class providing setup, configuration, and utility methods for CoAP protocol Integration Tests within Eclipse Hono. It includes methods for creating requests, handling responses, managing device/tenant registration, and test infrastructure.
